title: Revalidate detector type against the prepared worker route
answers: What happens if an alert's detector type changes during a check?
Why would an AI detector run on a worker without model credentials?
How should evaluation handle a detector type that no longer matches its queue?
body:
Symptom: Changing an alert to an AI detector during a check can send its model call to a worker without model credentials.
Root cause: posthog/temporal/alerts/activities.py:evaluate_alert reloads the alert after prepare has selected the task queue from the earlier detector type.
Fix pattern: Compare the loaded detector type with inputs.uses_llm_detector before selecting the executor; evaluate the same loaded snapshot only when they agree.
Constraints: On either direction of detector-type mismatch, return no check and no notification, preserve next_check_at, and let the next scheduler tick prepare and route again; only the AI worker holds model credentials.
applies: Alert evaluation when detector configuration can change between preparation and execution.
